pages.text: The Sample Vault: a 54-slot warehouse that only takes life samples, auto-merging same-source, same-purity stacks.$(br)Place it within 3 blocks of an Analyzer or Potion Table for linked access — mountains of samples, zero mess.

The Organ Vault: an organ freezer paged by body slot (9 pages × 9 slots + 9 staging).$(br)Organs auto-file into their slot page, consuming 1 life energy per tick to stay viable. Freeze them well and transplanting is a breeze.

The Potion Cabinet: a 54-slot warehouse that only takes potions, auto-merging same-template same-purity, with template filtering.$(br)Place it within 3 blocks of a Potion Table for linked access — a potion collector's paradise.
